decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-07-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the current National Livestock Policy, formulated in the year 2006, is required to be updated taking into account the challenges that have arisen in the field of food security and livestock development due to global and local social and economic transformations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to implement the National Livestock Policy, formulated by obtaining local expert advice and knowledge and covering areas such as private sector-led development, market-oriented competitive production, sustainable and environmental responsible development, support for small-scale farmers and rural livelihoods, and science and technology based development, was approved by the Cabinet.
